# updawg_policy (Data Source)

A live policy, by name, with the document in force. Needs the token scope `read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "updawg_policy" "baseline" {
  name = "baseline"
}

output "baseline_version" {
  value = data.updawg_policy.baseline.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The policy's name.

### Optional

- `org` (String) The organization's slug. Defaults to the provider's `org`.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is enabled.
- `id` (String) `pol_…`.
- `priority` (Number) Its priority.
- `version` (Number) The version in force.
- `yaml` (String) The document in force.
